title: Catpilot evidence event
description: One line of the evidence log written by the Claude Code hooks, the session-start script and the reference MCP server, schema version 1. Content-free: every value is a fixed label, an enumerated value, an opaque id or a hash. Never a command, a file path, file content, a prompt, a plan description, or a value from the company rules file. See docs/spec/EVIDENCE.md.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema. A line without it was written before version 1.

event_id.description: A random UUID for this line, written in lowercase. Unique per line; carries no meaning.

ts.description: When the line was written, in UTC to the second (2026-11-16T15:04:05+00:00).

source.description: The component that wrote the line: one of the PreToolUse hooks in hooks/claude-code/ (named for the event format they read, on whichever tool runs them; host says which), the reference MCP server, or the session-start script, which runs on Claude Code and Codex.

host.description: The AI tool the event came from, when the writer knows it: for a PreToolUse hook, claude-code or codex from its --host argument, and claude-code when it has none, as in every configuration written before the argument existed; claude-code or codex for the session-start script, from its --host argument. A hook whose --host was malformed or unknown has none. Absent when unknown: the server does not know which tool called it, a check called from a harness does not say, and a session-start line whose --host was missing or unknown has none. Never the machine's hostname.

event.description: What happened. Written today: deny and input_error (hooks), lookup (server), rules_delivered, rules_expired and policy_error (session-start script). ask and would_deny are reserved for the company-rules hooks.

rule_id.description: The id of the company rule that decided, when one did (docs/spec/OVERLAY_V2.md). Not written yet.

mode.description: The mode of the company rule that decided (docs/spec/OVERLAY_V2.md §2.3). Not written yet; the built-in checks have no mode.

policy_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the company rules file's bytes. The server writes it whenever it read and parsed the file. The session-start script writes the hash its private build recorded, on rules_delivered and rules_expired. The hooks load no rules file yet.

release.description: The CalVer release of the writer's content. The server writes the release of its guidance (mcp-server/defaults/guidance.json). The session-start script writes the release the company rules bundle was built from, when its sidecar names one of this shape. The hooks have no release of their own yet and leave it out.

session_id.description: The host's session id from the hook event, when it is an opaque identifier of this shape; otherwise absent.

session_source.description: Session-start script: how the session started, from the SessionStart event's source. Absent when the event did not say, or said something else.

block_chars.description: Session-start script, rules_delivered: the length in characters of the company rules block it read (company-checklist.md). A size, never the text.

block_lines.description: Session-start script, rules_delivered: the number of lines in the company rules block it read. A size, never the text.

hook.description: Which hook wrote the line. Lines written before the write hook's rename say pretooluse-write-private-key; they have no schema_version.

tool.description: For a hook, the host tool it checked. For the server, the MCP tool that was called.

label.description: A hook's fixed label for what it matched: a credential type, private-key-block, or a destructive-operation type. Never the matched text. On a session-start policy_error line, why the company rules could not be loaded: one of the values the session-start condition below lists.

error.description: Server: the tool's error code, or null when it answered.

policy_status.description: Server: the state of the company rules file for this call, or null when the tool returned an error.

unknown_policy.description: Server: true when no current approved company values were available, or null when the tool returned an error.

topic.description: Server, get_guidance: the topic asked for, or invalid.

category.description: Server, list_approved: the category asked for, or invalid.

kind.description: Server, get_template: the template kind asked for, or invalid.

outcome.description: Server, check_plan: the outcome, absent when the tool returned an error.

ask_a_human.description: Server, check_plan: whether the answer said to ask a human.

fields.description: Server, check_plan: the names of the fields the caller supplied, sorted. Never their values.
